Name: Pelican Chat
Author: mtxfujimi
Description:
[size=5][b]PelicanChat (Pelican4Ever.Chat)[/b][/size]
[b]A scrollable, tabbed, Discord-ready ChatBox overhaul for Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ (SMAPI 4.1.0+).[/b]

PelicanChat upgrades the vanilla Stardew Valley chat box into a modern multi-channel chat interface with smooth scrolling, unread badges, contextual tab routing, and an optional host-side Discord bridge. It works [b]100% standalone[/b] in vanilla/co-op games and integrates automatically with [b]Pelican 4Ever[/b] when installed.

[line]

[size=4][b]Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Extended History & Smooth Scrolling:[/b] Keeps up to [b]200 messages per channel[/b] (configurable from 10 to 2000) instead of vanilla's 10-line limit, with bounded height (280px open / 140px closed), mouse wheel scrolling,
[code]PageUp[/code]/
[code]PageDown[/code], and Scroll Lock while reading older messages.[/*]
[*][b]Channel Tabs & Unread Badges:[/b] [b]All[/b], [b]Local[/b] (proximity <= 30 tiles), [b]Global[/b], [b]Discord[/b], [b]Whispers[/b], and [b]Events[/b]. Switch tabs by clicking or pressing
[code]Tab[/code]/
[code]Shift+Tab[/code].[/*]
[*][b]Contextual Sending:[/b] Typing directly while on the [b]Local[/b] or [b]Discord[/b] tab automatically routes your message to that channel without needing to type
[code]/l[/code]or
[code]/d[/code]every time.[/*]
[*][b]Optional Discord Bridge (Host-only):[/b] Dedicated Discord channel with strict bracket/tag sanitization (
[code][color][/code]/
[code][emoji][/code]injection protection), loopback listener support, and zero bot tokens/secrets shared with clients.[/*]
[*][b]Standalone + Pelican 4Ever Integration:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Standalone mode:[/b] Provides
[code]/l[/code](
[code]/local[/code]),
[code]/g[/code](
[code]/global[/code]),
[code]/w[/code](alias for
[code]/message[/code]), and
[code]/d[/code](
[code]/discord[/code]).[/*]
[*][b]With Pelican 4Ever:[/b] Automatically hooks via SMAPI Mod API to sync server clock
[code][HH:mm][/code]timestamps, avoid command conflicts, classify server events, and bridge external chat.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Multilingual Support:[/b] Includes English, Spanish (
[code]es[/code]), and Simplified Chinese (
[code]zh-CN[/code]) translations.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15+[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.1.0+[/b][/*]
[/list][line]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.1.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Download [b]PelicanChat 0.1.0.zip[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]PelicanChat[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=4][b]Commands & Controls[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][code]Tab[/code]/
[code]Shift+Tab[/code](with chat open): Cycle between chat tabs.[/*]
[*][code]Mouse Wheel[/code]/
[code]PageUp[/code]/
[code]PageDown[/code]: Scroll through chat history.[/*]
[*][code]/l <message>[/code]or
[code]/local <message>[/code]: Send a proximity chat message (standalone mode).[/*]
[*][code]/g <message>[/code]or
[code]/global <message>[/code]: Send a global chat message (standalone mode).[/*]
[*][code]/w <player> <message>[/code]: Send a whisper (alias for
[code]/message[/code]in standalone mode).[/*]
[*][code]/d <message>[/code]or
[code]/discord <message>[/code]: Send a message to the bridged Discord channel.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=4][b]Configuration ([/b][/size]
[code]config.json[/code][size=4][b])[/b][/size]
Generated automatically on first launch inside
[code]Mods/PelicanChat/config.json[/code]:
[list]
[*][code]Enabled[/code](default:
[code]true[/code]) — Enable or disable the mod's visual and routing patches.[/*]
[*][code]MaxHistoryPerChannel[/code](default:
[code]200[/code], range: 10–2000) — Messages retained per tab.[/*]
[*][code]MaxVisibleHeight[/code](default:
[code]280[/code], range: 100–800) — Chat viewport height when open (px).[/*]
[*][code]MaxClosedHeight[/code](default:
[code]140[/code], range: 40–400) — Chat viewport height when closed (px).[/*]
[*][code]ShowTimestamps[/code](default:
[code]true[/code]) — Prefix messages with
[code][HH:mm][/code].[/*]
[*][code]TimestampSource[/code](default:
[code]"Auto"[/code]) —
[code]Auto[/code],
[code]ServerClock[/code], or
[code]LocalTime[/code].[/*]
[*][code]IncludeDiscordInAllTab[/code](default:
[code]true[/code]) — Show Discord messages in the [b]All[/b] tab.[/*]
[*][code]DefaultTab[/code](default:
[code]"All"[/code]) — Starting tab (
[code]All[/code],
[code]Local[/code],
[code]Global[/code],
[code]Discord[/code],
[code]Whisper[/code],
[code]System[/code]).[/*]
[*][code]ProximityRadius[/code](default:
[code]30.0[/code], range: 1–500) — Tile radius for standalone Local chat.[/*]
[*][code]CriticalToastDurationSeconds[/code](default:
[code]15[/code], range: 0–120) — Duration of cross-tab critical event toasts.[/*]
[*][code]DiscordBridgeEnabled[/code]/
[code]DiscordWebhookUrl[/code]/
[code]DiscordInboundPort[/code]/
[code]DiscordInboundToken[/code]/
[code]MaxInboundMessageLength[/code]— Optional host-only standalone Discord bridge settings.[/*]
[/list][line]
